newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba to hold news conference on 30-yr bond July 1.
newsitem.headline: Buba to hold news conference on 30-yr bond July 1.

text.p: The Bundesbank, acting in its capacity as issuing agent for the federal government, said on Tuesday that Bonn would issue a 30-year bond through a consortium and auction early next week.
A news conference will be held on July 1 at 1015 GMT to give details about the issue.
The federal bond consortium will meet on July 1 and tenders for the bond, to total no more than 10 billion marks, will be due on July 2 at 0900 GMT, the Bundesbank said on Tuesday.

As this bond is being issued as part of Germany's bid to lengthen its yield curve and is necessary for new plans to allow bond stripping, a news conference will take place to explain details about the plans, the Bundesbank said.
Bundesbank vice president Johann Wilhelm Gaddum and Juergen Stark, the state secretary in the Finance Ministry, will participate in the news conference.
